component.name: Corne HUD
Corne — екрани
component.summary: Live OLED screens for the Corne split keyboard
Живі OLED-екрани для розділеної клавіатури Corne

description.p: Corne HUD drives the two 128×32 OLED screens of a Corne keyboard over USB Raw HID: a clock, CPU/GPU temperatures and battery, the current keyboard layout, a music spectrum, a Bongo cat that taps along with your typing, 19 animations, your own pictures and GIFs, and drawing directly on the keyboard screen.

ul.li: Choose the mode of each screen half separately
Live audio spectrum and waveform of whatever is playing
Clock, CPU and RAM load and the current track from any MPRIS player
Pictures and GIFs with dithering, threshold, inversion and cropping
Pixel editor with frames, 15 effects and live drawing on the keyboard
A lightweight background service keeps the screens alive without the window

description.p: Requires the companion Vial/QMK firmware and a udev rule that grants access to the keyboard.
English interface, Windows and macOS builds, Linux packages (deb, rpm, AppImage, Flatpak).
